purpose: Precommit the interpretation and next-step routing for the already-running winner-independent policy-refit stability decomposition before its aggregate result is available. This file does not select H2 or H3 and does not change any frozen Phase2 gate.

interpretation_axes.threshold_usage: The existing Phase2 0.15/0.35 values may be shown as reference thresholds in this diagnostic only. They are not a new H2/H3 selection gate.

routing.meaning: A material portion of the original cross-seed divergence is created during final AveragePolicy fitting even on identical frozen strategy memory.
routing.next_required_work: Freeze and run a winner-independent AveragePolicy stabilization experiment that isolates initialization, minibatch ordering and optimization convergence. Do not rerun H2-vs-H3 strategic selection until a stabilized training protocol is frozen and independently rerun.
routing.forbidden_shortcut: Do not choose whichever of H2/H3 happened to have lower diagnostic TV.

routing.meaning: The divergence is already present in the strategy memories generated before final AveragePolicy fitting.
routing.next_required_work: Freeze a winner-independent upstream randomness decomposition. At minimum separate deal/traversal sampling from model initialization/batch randomness and include exact same-seed determinism controls. Do not change the original Phase2 gates.
routing.forbidden_shortcut: Do not compensate by merely increasing final-policy optimizer steps.

routing.meaning: Both the upstream Deep-CFR path and the final AveragePolicy fit materially contribute to instability.
routing.next_required_work: Stabilize and validate the final AveragePolicy learner first because it can be isolated on immutable memories, then decompose and stabilize the upstream path. Afterwards rerun the full independent-seed Phase2 stability gate.
routing.forbidden_shortcut: Do not average the two problems away with an ensemble and call the original gate passed unless an ensemble production protocol is separately precommitted and fully rerun.

routing.meaning: The simple decomposition does not reproduce the original instability source; an interaction, continuation-state, checkpoint, or training-sequence effect remains.
routing.next_required_work: Freeze a full-path exact-rerun/determinism audit and compare original checkpoints, memory identities, optimizer/RNG states and continuation sequence before proposing any training change.
routing.forbidden_shortcut: Do not declare the original blocker spurious.

path_to_h2_h3_decision: Complete the current 16-cell decomposition and persist its aggregate result.
Follow exactly the matching root-cause routing branch above and freeze the remediation protocol before its outputs.
Demonstrate that the resulting full training pipeline is stable across independent training seeds under the unchanged Phase2 cross-seed gates in both TRUE_HEADS_UP and THREE_HANDED.

Only after hard-gate admission, reapply the already-frozen H2-vs-H3 strategic selection rule: local-deviation proxy primary, mirrored pairwise crossplay secondary, material floor 0.001 ICM, with no common-reference winner role.
If both candidates pass all hard gates and the strategic comparisons remain materially inconclusive, select H2 by the already-frozen smaller/faster tie-break.
